title: slots.shimme.rs insights
description: The play-money casino's economy, games and players, from the numbers the slots server pushes into VictoriaMetrics (src/metrics.rs).

panels.title: Coins held by everyone
panels.description: All players' balances together, as of the last five minutes, with how it got there.

panels.title: Jackpot
panels.description: The shared pot. A round takes it with probability XP x 1.25% / the pot, so it has no cap.

panels.title: Players today
panels.description: Signed in or played in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Playing now
panels.description: Browser tabs open on the site right now.

panels.title: Site
panels.description: https://slots.shimme.rs/healthz, as the status probe sees it.

panels.title: Rounds played
panels.description: In the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Coins wagered
panels.description: In the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: House take
panels.description: Wagered less paid out, jackpots included. Below zero the players are ahead.

targets.expr: (sum(sum_over_time(slots_wagered_coins{game=~".*"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) - ((sum(sum_over_time(slots_won_coins{game=~".*"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(sum_over_time(slots_jackpot_paid_coins{game=~".*"}[$__range])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Paid back
panels.description: Paid out over wagered: the return players really got in the time range.

targets.expr: ((sum(sum_over_time(slots_won_coins{game=~".*"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(sum_over_time(slots_jackpot_paid_coins{game=~".*"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) / (sum(sum_over_time(slots_wagered_coins{game=~".*"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Coins handed out
panels.description: Every reward, the daily wheel and refills; not the welcome balance.

panels.title: Jackpots won
panels.description: In the dashboard's time range.

options.content: Coins enter as **gifts** (welcome balance, wheel, rewards) and as **wins**; they leave as **stakes**. Green goes to players, red to the house, purple is handed out.

panels.title: Coins held by everyone
panels.description: Every coin comes from a gift, a round or a gamble; the history is worked back from today's balances, from the first round on.

panels.title: Coins in and out
panels.description: What moved in each step: stakes below the line, everything that reached the players above it.

panels.title: Where gifts come from
panels.description: Coins handed out in the time range, by kind.

panels.title: House take against gifts
panels.description: When purple outgrows red, coins pile up in the players' balances.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time(slots_wagered_coins{game=~".*"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval)) - (sum(sum_over_time(slots_won_coins{game=~".*"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval)) or vector(0)) - (sum(sum_over_time(slots_jackpot_paid_coins{game=~".*"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval)) or vector(0))

panels.title: Return to players, over the last 24 hours
panels.description: Paid out over wagered in the day up to each moment. In the shaded part the players were ahead that day.

options.content: Every game keeps its colour on every panel. Figures are for the dashboard's time range unless a panel says otherwise.

panels.title: Game by game
panels.description: Paid back is green below 100% and turns orange and red as players come out ahead; a handful of rounds swings wildly.

targets.expr: sum by (game)(sum_over_time(slots_won_coins{game=~".*"}[$__range])) + (sum by (game)(sum_over_time(slots_jackpot_paid_coins{game=~".*"}[$__range])) or sum by (game)(sum_over_time(slots_won_coins{game=~".*"}[$__range])) * 0)

(sum by (game)(sum_over_time(slots_won_coins{game=~".*"}[$__range])) + (sum by (game)(sum_over_time(slots_jackpot_paid_coins{game=~".*"}[$__range])) or sum by (game)(sum_over_time(slots_won_coins{game=~".*"}[$__range])) * 0)) / sum by (game)(sum_over_time(slots_wagered_coins{game=~".*"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Paid back since the very start
panels.description: Every round ever played on each game, jackpots included.

panels.title: Big wins
panels.description: Rounds that paid 10 times the bet or more, by game.

options.content: Balances, levels and stickers are recorded from when the dashboard was set up; rounds and who played go back to the first round.

panels.title: Players each day
panels.description: Distinct players with at least one round in each day.

panels.title: Up or down in the time range
panels.description: What each player's rounds paid them less what they staked.

panels.title: Players on each level
panels.description: How many players have reached each level.
